# xp32 magic animation sources

These 79 HKX files come from **New Animation for Magic Casting (OAR version)**
by Neumeria, based on **New Animation for Magic Casting SSE** by xp32.

- OAR port: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/104120
- Original SSE mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/31989
- Installed source version: 1.0.0.0 (Nexus mod 104120)

The OAR port states that it uses the original mod's permissions. The original
author allows upload to other sites, modification, conversion, and reuse of the
assets with credit. DAF does not enable Donation Points for these assets.

Dragon Aspect Flight uses the casting/idling clips only while its own flight
graph variables are active. Ground locomotion clips from this source are not
shipped directly as DAF winners; the build maps those original filenames to
DAF's root-stable flight loop so they cannot make the player walk on air.

Credits: xp32 (original animations), Neumeria (OAR port), NickNak (DAF aerial
lower-body/attack animation sources).
